name: POST /api/public/introduction-requests - a company asks to be introduced (opt-in routing)
description: No sign-in. A device company asks to be introduced to a regulatory consultant: companyName, contactName, contactEmail, brief (20-2000 characters), optional productCode (its FDA medical specialty is then taken from FDA's classification) or specialty, pathway (510k, de_novo, pma, unsure), consent: true (required: the request may be shared with matched firms), and a hidden honeypot 'website'. Routing (F6.2 AC1): a company's request is offered only to firms that opted in and whose FDA medical specialties and pathways match (a firm listing none takes any); up to 3 firms, longest since their last offer first. Fixture 53_introductions.py proves it across three firms (opted in and matching, matching but not opted in, opted in but another specialty). Returns only the new id. INTRO_REQUESTS_PER_IP_PER_HOUR (default 5) per hashed IP, then 429.

payload.brief: {{static:FICTIONAL TEST DATA: a novel intraocular implant; we need a regulatory consultant.}}

errorCases.message: You must agree that your request may be shared with consultant firms
errorCases.when: consent missing or false, a required field missing, brief too short, bad email, product code or specialty, or an unknown field

errorCases.message: This request could not be accepted.
Product code ZZZ is not in our copy of the FDA classification database
Too many requests. Please try again in an hour.
errorCases.when: too many requests from one IP
